verdict.line: You lose if he ults you alone after 6 and steals your stats mid-duel; you win if you burst him inside 50+ Fury before he can shield-heal it off.

brief.thesis: This matchup is a fight over one interaction: Mordekaiser's W (Indestructible) banks damage into a shield he pops to heal, and Renekton's fury-empowered W (Ruthless Predator) is one of the few things that outright destroys a damage shield on hit. Land the empowered version right after he casts W and you erase his sustain for that trade; miss the window and he heals it back for free. The 46.7% win rate over 182 games and even lane grade reflect a real skill matchup, not a bad lane — his advantage is entirely in the solo-kill column, which lines up with what his R (Realm of Death) does to you if you're caught alone after level 6.

theirWindow.when: he's landed 3 hits on you (Darkness Rise up)
theirWindow.what: Once Darkness Rise procs he gets a damage aura and move speed, so an extended stand-and-trade now favors him. Disengage rather than keep swinging once you see his aura pop.

yourWindow.when: your Fury is over 50 and he just cast W
yourWindow.what: Empowered W lands three slashes, deals high damage, stuns for 1.5s, and destroys any shield he's stored — dash in with E first, then fire W the instant he's cast Indestructible so the shield has nothing banked yet or gets wiped outright.

start.why: Most-picked start in this matchup (80.3% pick, 43.9% WR over 187 games) — the extra sustain and AD help you win the short trades you need before his Obliterate scales up.

boots.why: Most-picked boots here (69.5% pick, 45.9% WR) and Mordekaiser is entirely magic damage, so the flat MR directly reduces every Obliterate and Death's Grasp tick.

core.why: Highest-picked core path start (15.3% pick) — the proc shield absorbs a chunk of an Obliterate poke and rewards your dash-in trade pattern.
Armor shred stacks with your empowered E's own armor reduction, letting your all-in ramp damage across the fight.
Bleed-and-heal sustain lets you keep resetting HP between skirmishes instead of losing the war of attrition to his shield-heal.

situational.when: he's landing clean Obliterate-into-Death's Grasp combos and you need the spell shield to survive a burst window
you're ahead and want to survive being isolated by his R rather than dying to the stat-steal duel

runes.keystoneWhy: Most-picked keystone here (37.7% pick, 45.3% WR) — the stacking adaptive damage and healing let you outlast his Indestructible sustain in a prolonged trade instead of losing the war of attrition.

summoners.why: Dominant pick in this matchup (91.7% pick, 46.9% WR). Ignite matters specifically here — it applies Grievous Wounds, which cuts directly into the heal he gets from popping his Indestructible shield mid-all-in.

playing.title: Punish his W the instant he casts it
playing.detail: Dash in with E then fire empowered W (50+ Fury) right after he casts Indestructible. The three-slash version destroys the shield outright before he can bank enough damage into it to heal.

playing.title: Keep trades short to deny his passive
playing.detail: Darkness Rise needs 3 landed attacks or spells on you to trigger his damage aura and speed buff. Land your burst (Q into E) and disengage rather than standing in extended exchanges.

playing.title: All-in between levels 3 and 5
playing.detail: Your W-into-E stun chain is fully online here and his R isn't. This is your best kill window in the whole lane.

playing.title: Respect Death's Grasp range at 700
playing.detail: He can pull you into a fight from further than you expect. Don't sit at half health inside that range or he starts the engage on his terms.

playing.title: Play safe from level 6 onward when alone
playing.detail: Realm of Death drags you into an isolated duel and steals a portion of your stats on a kill, which is exactly where his solo-kill edge in this matchup comes from. Don't skirmish far from vision or allies after 6.

playing.title: Ignite his all-in, not just his HP
playing.detail: Landing Ignite during your burst window denies the heal he'd otherwise get from consuming his stored Indestructible shield.

playing.title: Track your own Fury bar every trade
playing.detail: Below 50 Fury, your Q and W are the weaker versions and won't threaten his shield or land the long stun — wait for the Fury spike before you commit to an all-in.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, runes, summoners, and win rates above are pulled from measured OP.GG games on the current patch; the mechanical reasoning — why the empowered W matters against Indestructible, the passive-denial trade pattern, and the level-6 danger window — is our own tactical read, not measured data.

stats.opponentTip: Use Renkton’s reinforced [W] when Mordekaiser uses his (W). Deal singular bursts of damage to prevent Mordekaiser’s (P) from staying active.
